<title level="1" pfs="Standard">[Vordine (Infantry Devil)](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2906)</title>

<row gap="medium">

<column gap="medium" flex="1 1 400px">

The vast city of Dis trains endless legions of vordines to guard the upper layers of Hell and march across the planes at the archdevils' orders. Although quick to bend their knees to higher-ranking devils and even mortals favored by [Asmodeus](/Deities.aspx?ID=278), vordines are relentlessly cruel to [orts](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2905) and other devils they can call their subordinates.

 Although higher ranks in the infernal military are held by more powerful devils, like the nessari who serve as generals, a labyrinthine structure gives each vordine a rank and certain responsibilities. Some vordines are responsible for the battlefield command of squads, while others relay orders from above or are set to handling specific administrative tasks for their unit. The greatest gift one can offer a vordine is an increased rank to lord over other vordines.

[Common](/Languages.aspx?ID=1), [Diabolic](/Languages.aspx?ID=117); [telepathy](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=79) 100 feet

[Acrobatics](/Skills.aspx?ID=1) +13, [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) +15, [Intimidation](/Skills.aspx?ID=7) +13, [Warfare Lore](/Skills.aspx?ID=8) +13, [Religion](/Skills.aspx?ID=13) +12

<row gap="medium">

<row gap="medium">

**Ref** +13

+1 status to all saves vs. [magic](/Traits.aspx?ID=644)
</row>

<row gap="medium">
**HP** 60

</row>

**Immunities**
[fire](/Traits.aspx?ID=604)

**Resistances**
physical 5 (except [silver](/Equipment.aspx?ID=379)), [poison](/Traits.aspx?ID=669) 5

**Weaknesses**
[holy](/Traits.aspx?ID=517) 5

**[Reactive Strike](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=48)** <actions string="Reaction" /> 

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

**Speed** 25 feet

**Melee**
<actions string="Single Action" />
trident +15 ([Magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=103), [Unholy](/Traits.aspx?ID=521)),
**Damage** 1d8+10 piercing

**Melee**
<actions string="Single Action" />
hoof +15 ([Agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=170), [Magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=103), [Unholy](/Traits.aspx?ID=521)),
**Damage** 1d4+7 bludgeoning plus 1d4 fire

**Ranged**
<actions string="Single Action" />
trident +13 ([Magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=103), [thrown 20 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=195), [Unholy](/Traits.aspx?ID=521)),
**Damage** 1d8+10 piercing

**Melee**
<actions string="Single Action" />
whip +15 ([Unholy](/Traits.aspx?ID=521), [Disarm](/Traits.aspx?ID=577), [Magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=644), [Nonlethal](/Traits.aspx?ID=661), [reach 10 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=684), [Trip](/Traits.aspx?ID=716)),
**Damage** 1d4+10 bludgeoning

**Divine Innate Spells** DC 19
- **4th**
[Translocate](/Spells.aspx?ID=1724) (at will)

**Rituals** DC 19

- **1st**
[Diabolic Pact](/Rituals.aspx?ID=143)

**Burning Hoofprints** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([Divine](/Traits.aspx?ID=48), [Fire](/Traits.aspx?ID=72), [Unholy](/Traits.aspx?ID=521)) The vordine Strides, trailing hoofprints in each square they exit. The hoofprints burn for 1 minute. A creature on the ground that enters a square with burning hoofprints or begins its turn in one takes 1d4 fire damage.

**Trident of Dis** <actions string="Single Action" />  The vordine makes a trident Strike, increasing their reach to 10 feet for that Strike. If there is an [unholy](/Traits.aspx?ID=521) ally between the vordine and their target, that creature's energy causes the Strike to deal an additional 1d6 spirit damage.

</column>
